Brutal theme (WordPress)

Justin Jackson’s open-source WordPress theme, made to carry the plain-page ideas of his essay “This is a web page”.

Source
GitHub: mijustin/brutal-theme
Creator
Justin Jackson, after a design by Kyle Fox
Made
2016
Style
Brutalist web design (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Plain, honest
Evidence
Read the README and style.css on GitHub on 2026-10-02. Repository created 27 September 2016 (GitHub API). The bundled screenshot.png is only 600 × 450 px, so the look is not recorded as observed.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: GPL-2.0. Rights policy

Context

README: “A brutalist WordPress theme”, “inspired by two of my essays”: This is a web page and “I’m a fucking websmaster”. “The original design came from Kyle Fox.”

style.css sets font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; max-width: 46em, h1 { font-size: 1.5em }, h2 { font-size: 1.2em }, h3 { font-size: 1em }, and square list bullets. Theme tags: one-column, light.

NN/g (2017) cites Justin Jackson’s blog for “the black and blue Monospace typography often seen in brutalist sites”.

Why it belongs

Shows how small the type scale of the style is: here the largest heading is only 1.5 times the body.
